contents.initial_reducer: Linux FUSE send trace has trailing whitespace. Stripping record text fixed offline matching. Original errors retained.
contents.lookup_expectation: On the first candidate, pinned Linux LOOKUP supplies three input arguments. It took the ordinary fallback; the APFS VM did not exercise packed LOOKUP. Initial layout hypothesis rejected for LOOKUP. OPEN, GETATTR, READ and RELEASE were packed.
contents.evidence: The host analyzer checks submission/reply match by PID, unique, connection and request pointer, with >1058 matched LOOKUP, OPEN and READ per arm. Both captures are immutable.
